en: I-I don't wanna die...I don't wanna die...

<CLT=cltMIND>Is Kokichi going to be okay?
Maybe I should stay by his side...

What? Are you here to offer your life as
tribute for me, Kaede?

Nee-heehee! Don't worry! It'd be boring to kill
you now, so I won't do anything of the sort!

<CLT=cltMIND>I spent some time trying to prevent Kokichi
from doing anything stupid...
<CLT=cltMIND>Kokichi and I grew a little closer today.
